senses.en: painful, especially when touched or moved
a painful damaged area on the skin
upset or annoyed about something unfair or disappointing

ex.en: My legs are sore after yesterday's long walk.
ex.zh: 昨天走了很远的路，我的腿现在酸痛。

ex.en: Office workers may develop sore muscles if they remain seated without taking regular breaks.
ex.zh: 上班族如果久坐而不定时休息，可能会出现肌肉酸痛。

tip: sore常修饰身体部位，如a sore throat。

senses.en: a running race of about 42 kilometres
something long and tiring that tests your patience

ex.en: My uncle finished his first marathon in just under four hours.
ex.zh: 我叔叔不到四小时就跑完了他的第一次马拉松。

ex.en: The city holds a marathon every spring to raise money for local schools.
ex.zh: 这座城市每年春天举办马拉松，为当地学校筹款。

col: a marathon of meetings｜马拉松式的会议
tip: marathon 可比喻“漫长而累人的事”，如 a marathon of exams。

senses.en: an outdoor event with rides and games

ex.en: The children were excited to visit the funfair on Saturday.
ex.zh: 孩子们很兴奋周六去游乐场。

ex.en: The annual funfair in the town attracts thousands of visitors every summer.
ex.zh: 镇上一年一度的游乐场每年夏天吸引成千上万的游客。

col: go to the funfair｜去游乐场
tip: funfair是英式英语，美式常用carnival或amusement park。

senses.en: An exercise raising and lowering your body using your arms.

ex.en: I managed one push-up before my arms started shaking.
ex.zh: 我做了一个俯卧撑，胳膊就开始发抖了。

ex.en: Simple exercises such as push-ups allow people to build strength without paying for expensive gym memberships.
ex.zh: 俯卧撑等简单运动让人们无需支付昂贵的健身房会员费就能增强力量。

col: a set of push-ups｜一组俯卧撑
tip: 可数名词；英式英语也常用press-up。

senses.en: A statement about what is expected to happen in the future.

ex.en: Your prediction was right: it rained all afternoon.
ex.zh: 你预测对了：整个下午都在下雨。

ex.en: Accurate predictions of future energy demand are essential for planning reliable and sustainable electricity supplies.
ex.zh: 准确预测未来能源需求，对于规划可靠且可持续的电力供应至关重要。

tip: 作出预测用make a prediction，不用do。

senses.en: a number expressing an amount, especially in official information
a person, their outline, or the shape of their body
to think or decide something after considering it

ex.en: She checked the final figure on the bill.
ex.zh: 她核对了账单上的最终金额。

ex.en: Recent employment figures suggest that investment in public transport can create substantial opportunities for local workers.
ex.zh: 近期就业数据显示，投资公共交通能为当地劳动者创造大量机会。

tip: 数据常用复数figures；figure out意为弄懂。

senses.en: a very hard mineral used in jewellery and cutting tools
a shape with four equal sides and opposite angles equal

ex.en: A tiny diamond sparkled on her silver ring.
ex.zh: 她的银戒指上，一颗小钻石闪闪发光。

ex.en: The diamond industry faces growing pressure to demonstrate that its mining practices protect workers and local ecosystems.
ex.zh: 钻石行业面临越来越大的压力，需要证明其采矿活动能够保护工人和当地生态系统。

tip: diamond指金刚石或钻石；菱形的几何术语是rhombus。

senses.en: an older term for a female aircraft or ship attendant

ex.en: My grandmother worked as a stewardess before becoming a teacher.
ex.zh: 我祖母当教师之前做过空姐。

ex.en: The replacement of stewardess with flight attendant reflects a broader shift towards gender-neutral language in professional settings.
ex.zh: 用flight attendant替代stewardess，体现了职业场合用语向性别中立转变的更广泛趋势。

col: work as a stewardess｜担任女乘务员
airline stewardess｜航空公司女乘务员
tip: 较旧且限定女性；现代通常用flight attendant。

senses.en: a plastic case containing magnetic tape for recording sound

ex.en: We found an old cassette of songs in the cupboard.
ex.zh: 我们在柜子里找到了一盒录着歌曲的旧磁带。

ex.en: Before digital streaming became widespread, many language learners used cassette recordings to practise listening at home.
ex.zh: 在数字流媒体普及之前，许多语言学习者用盒式磁带录音在家练习听力。

tip: 注意重音在第二音节；播放器叫cassette player。

senses.en: very attractive and easy to love

ex.en: The little girl gave her mother an adorable smile.
ex.zh: 小女孩给了她妈妈一个可爱的微笑。

ex.en: Many students find the baby animals at the school farm absolutely adorable and love to visit them.
ex.zh: 许多学生觉得学校农场里的动物宝宝非常可爱，喜欢去看它们。

tip: adorable 常用于口语，形容小孩、小动物或小物件可爱。

senses.en: A wide-mouthed container, often glass, with a lid.
To feel unpleasant or clash with something.
To shake suddenly and sharply, sometimes causing pain.

ex.en: She keeps homemade jam in a small glass jar.
ex.zh: 她把自制果酱装在一个小玻璃罐里。

ex.en: Reusing glass jars for food storage can help households reduce their reliance on disposable plastic packaging.
ex.zh: 重复使用玻璃罐储存食品可以帮助家庭减少对一次性塑料包装的依赖。

col: a jar of honey｜一罐蜂蜜
jar with the surroundings｜与周围环境不协调
tip: jar 常指有盖广口罐；a jar of 后接所装物。

senses.en: a woman whose job is selling things

ex.en: The saleswoman explained the return policy clearly and politely.
ex.zh: 那位女售货员清楚而礼貌地解释了退货政策。

ex.en: A successful saleswoman must know her products and understand what customers really need.
ex.zh: 成功的女推销员必须了解产品，也明白顾客真正需要什么。

col: a car saleswoman｜女汽车销售员
the saleswoman at the desk｜柜台前的女售货员
tip: 复数 saleswomen /ˈseɪlzwɪmɪn/；若无性别必要，用 salesperson 更好。

senses.en: to remove writing or marks completely
to make a feeling or memory disappear

ex.en: She erased the wrong answer with a small rubber.
ex.zh: 她用一块小橡皮擦掉了错误的答案。

ex.en: New technology may erase some old jobs, but it also creates completely new kinds of work.
ex.zh: 新技术可能消除一些旧工作，但也会创造全新的工作。

col: be erased from memory｜从记忆中被抹去
tip: eraser 是橡皮，erasure 是删除行为；erase 强调彻底去掉痕迹。

senses.en: Successfully reach a goal or result through effort.

ex.en: With daily practice, she finally achieved her swimming goal.
ex.zh: 通过每天练习，她终于实现了自己的游泳目标。

ex.en: Governments can achieve significant reductions in air pollution by investing in clean energy and improving public transport.
ex.zh: 政府可以通过投资清洁能源和改善公共交通，大幅减少空气污染。

tip: 直接接目标或成果，不说achieve to do。

senses.en: containing a lot of moisture in the air

ex.en: It feels so humid that my shirt sticks to me.
ex.zh: 天气湿热得我的衬衫都贴在身上了。

ex.en: In humid climates, buildings require effective ventilation to prevent mould growth and protect residents' health.
ex.zh: 在潮湿气候中，建筑物需要有效通风，以防止霉菌滋生并保护居民健康。

tip: humid主要形容空气或气候潮湿，不用于湿衣服。

senses.en: the period of life when someone is young
young people considered as a group
a young man, especially a teenager

ex.en: My grandmother spent her youth in a seaside village.
ex.zh: 我祖母的青年时代是在一个海边村庄度过的。

ex.en: Investment in youth services can give young people valuable skills and strengthen their sense of belonging.
ex.zh: 对青年服务的投资能让年轻人掌握实用技能，并增强他们的归属感。

col: in one's youth｜在某人年轻时
tip: 表示青春通常不可数；a youth指一名年轻男子。

senses.en: a traditional or usual way of behaving
made to meet a particular customer's needs
the business customers give to a shop or company

ex.en: Sharing a meal is an important custom in our family.
ex.zh: 一起吃饭是我们家的一项重要惯例。

ex.en: Schools can introduce children to local customs while encouraging respect for traditions from other cultures.
ex.zh: 学校可以向孩子们介绍当地风俗，同时鼓励他们尊重其他文化的传统。

tip: custom指风俗或惯例；customs还可指海关。

senses.en: so interesting that it holds your attention completely

ex.en: The guide told us fascinating stories about the castle.
ex.zh: 导游给我们讲了关于这座城堡的精彩故事。

ex.en: Museum collections offer fascinating insights into how earlier societies adapted to changes in their natural environments.
ex.zh: 博物馆藏品让人们深入了解早期社会如何适应自然环境的变化，令人着迷。

tip: 事物令人着迷用fascinating；人着迷用fascinated。

senses.en: a person from the Arab world
relating to Arabs or their culture

ex.en: My friend is an Arab and he speaks three languages.
ex.zh: 我的朋友是阿拉伯人，他会说三种语言。

ex.en: Arab culture has made important contributions to mathematics, medicine and literature.
ex.zh: 阿拉伯文化对数学、医学和文学做出了重要贡献。

tip: Arab指人或文化；Arabic指阿拉伯语；Arabian指阿拉伯半岛的。

senses.en: The part of the day when there is natural light.
Happening or existing during the day rather than at night.

ex.en: The cat usually sleeps indoors during the daytime.
ex.zh: 这只猫白天通常在屋里睡觉。

ex.en: Higher daytime temperatures may force outdoor workers to adjust their schedules during the summer months.
ex.zh: 夏季白天气温升高，可能迫使户外工作者调整工作时间。

tip: 常说in the daytime；作定语时不加the。

senses.en: in or to any place, regardless of where
used in questions to express surprise about a place

ex.en: You can sit wherever you feel most comfortable.
ex.zh: 你觉得哪里最舒服，就可以坐在哪里。

ex.en: Governments should ensure that children receive a good education wherever they live, including in remote rural communities.
ex.zh: 政府应确保儿童无论住在哪里，包括偏远农村地区，都能接受良好教育。

col: wherever possible｜在任何可能的地方
wherever you go｜无论你去哪里
wherever you live｜无论你住在哪里
tip: 表示“无论哪里”时，相当于no matter where。

senses.en: a group of people chosen to make decisions or plans

ex.en: The school committee meets every Monday to discuss student activities.
ex.zh: 学校委员会每周一开会讨论学生活动。

ex.en: A committee of teachers and parents was set up to choose the new library books.
ex.zh: 一个由老师和家长组成的委员会被成立来挑选新图书馆书籍。

col: set up a committee｜成立委员会
tip: committee 是集合名词，作主语时谓语可用单数或复数，视强调整体还是成员。

senses.en: Your name written in your own distinctive way
Distinctive and closely associated with a particular person or place

ex.en: The delivery driver asked for my signature at the door.
ex.zh: 送货司机在门口请我签名。

ex.en: Electronic signatures allow businesses to complete agreements remotely, reducing delays and the need for paper documents.
ex.zh: 电子签名让企业能够远程签订协议，减少延误和纸质文件的使用。

tip: signature通常指签名；名人纪念签名常用autograph。

senses.en: completely or without any doubt
used to express strong agreement with someone

ex.en: The kitchen was absolutely spotless after we cleaned it.
ex.zh: 我们打扫后，厨房一尘不染。

ex.en: Reliable internet access is absolutely essential for students participating in online courses from remote communities.
ex.zh: 对于偏远社区参加在线课程的学生来说，可靠的网络连接必不可少。

tip: 常修饰essential等极限形容词，不常说absolutely good。

senses.en: connected with religion
believing strongly in a religion

ex.en: The town has many religious buildings, such as temples and old churches.
ex.zh: 这个小镇有许多宗教建筑，比如庙宇和古老教堂。

ex.en: Students learn about different religious traditions to understand the customs of people around the world.
ex.zh: 学生了解不同的宗教传统，以理解世界各地人们的习俗。

tip: 注意重音在第二音节；名词 religion，副词 religiously 常表“经常地”。

senses.en: physical power that moves something or changes its shape
to make someone do something against their wishes
physical strength used to control or overpower someone

ex.en: The force of the wind blew my umbrella inside out.
ex.zh: 大风把我的伞吹翻了。

ex.en: Rising housing costs may force essential workers to move further away from the communities they serve.
ex.zh: 不断上涨的住房成本可能迫使必要岗位的工作人员搬离他们服务的社区。

col: force someone to do something｜迫使某人做某事
tip: “迫使某人做某事”用force somebody to do something。

senses.en: paintings, drawings or other art objects
pictures printed in a book or magazine

ex.en: The museum shows artwork by young local students every spring.
ex.zh: 博物馆每年春天展出当地年轻学生的艺术作品。

ex.en: Visitors should not touch the artwork on display, because even clean hands can damage old paintings.
ex.zh: 参观者不应触摸展出的艺术品，因为即使干净的手也会损坏古画。

col: a piece of artwork｜一件艺术品
tip: artwork 多指具体作品，不可数；指多件作品也说 works of art。

senses.en: a short pole with a flat blade used to move a boat
to move a small boat through water with a paddle

ex.en: The children took turns using the paddle in the small boat.
ex.zh: 孩子们轮流在小船上用桨划水。

ex.en: Many tourists paddle along the quiet river to enjoy the green hills.
ex.zh: 许多游客沿着安静的河划船，欣赏青山。

col: paddle in the shallow water｜在浅水里蹚水
tip: paddle 指短桨或划小船；row 多指用长桨划，注意区分。

senses.en: Someone who deliberately and unlawfully kills another person.

ex.en: The detective finally identified the murderer in the novel.
ex.zh: 小说中的侦探终于查明了谁是谋杀犯。

ex.en: Documentaries about convicted murderers should avoid sensationalism and consider the feelings of victims' families.
ex.zh: 有关已定罪谋杀犯的纪录片应避免煽情，并顾及受害者家属的感受。

col: identify the murderer｜查明谋杀犯身份
tip: 指故意非法杀人者；killer的含义更广。

senses.en: A television service or route for communicating and distributing things
A passage of water connecting areas or allowing boats through
Direct energy, money, or resources towards a particular purpose

ex.en: Could you change the channel before the film starts?
ex.zh: 电影开始前，你能换个频道吗？

ex.en: Governments should channel more funding into public transport to reduce congestion and improve access to employment.
ex.zh: 政府应将更多资金投入公共交通，以缓解拥堵并便利人们上班求职。

tip: 动词常用channel sth into sth，表示将资源投入某处。

senses.en: a loving relationship or the excitement and affection surrounding love
a story or film mainly about love

ex.en: Their romance began during a walking holiday in the mountains.
ex.zh: 他们的恋情始于一次山间徒步假期。

ex.en: Popular films often portray romance in idealised ways, which may shape young people's expectations of relationships.
ex.zh: 流行电影常以理想化的方式描绘爱情，这可能影响年轻人对恋爱关系的期待。

col: a whirlwind romance｜迅速发展的恋情
tip: 泛指爱情常不可数；指一段恋情或一部作品可数。

senses.en: a way taken to get from one place to another
to send someone or something along a particular path

ex.en: We took a different route home to avoid traffic.
ex.zh: 我们换了一条路线回家，以避开拥堵。

ex.en: Expanding bus routes to rural communities would improve access to employment and essential public services.
ex.zh: 将公交线路延伸至农村社区，有助于居民获得就业机会和基本公共服务。

tip: 美式也读 /raʊt/；route 强调行进路线。

senses.en: Very useful or important for a particular purpose.
Worth a large amount of money.

ex.en: My neighbour gave me valuable advice about growing tomatoes.
ex.zh: 邻居给了我一些种番茄的宝贵建议。

ex.en: Work placements provide valuable experience that helps students develop practical skills before entering full-time employment.
ex.zh: 实习提供宝贵经验，帮助学生在正式就业前培养实践技能。

tip: 贵重物品用复数valuables；invaluable意为极宝贵的。

senses.en: of the face
a beauty treatment for the face

ex.en: She washed her facial skin with cold water.
ex.zh: 她用冷水洗了洗脸部皮肤。

ex.en: The study found that facial expressions can show whether a person is happy or sad.
ex.zh: 研究发现，面部表情能显示一个人是快乐还是悲伤。

tip: 注意与“face”区分：facial是形容词，face是名词或动词。

senses.en: connected with history or events in the past

ex.en: We found historical photographs of our street in the library.
ex.zh: 我们在图书馆找到了这条街过去的照片。

ex.en: Historical records help researchers understand how earlier societies responded to environmental change and economic uncertainty.
ex.zh: 历史记录帮助研究人员了解过去的社会如何应对环境变化和经济不确定性。

tip: historical指与历史有关；historic强调具有历史意义。

senses.en: unidentified flying object

senses.zh: 飞碟（科幻中的外星飞船）
senses.en: a spacecraft from another planet in stories

ex.en: Some people claim they saw a UFO in the sky last night.
ex.zh: 有些人声称昨晚在天空中看到了不明飞行物。

ex.en: Scientists study UFO reports carefully to find out whether they are real or just mistakes.
ex.zh: 科学家仔细研究不明飞行物的报告，以查明它们是真的还是只是错误。

col: UFO sighting｜不明飞行物目击事件
tip: UFO是缩写，读作/ˌjuː ef ˈəʊ/，复数直接加-s：UFOs。

senses.en: Medical treatment involving cutting into the body.
The functioning or management of a machine, system, or business.
A planned activity involving several people working together.

ex.en: My aunt is recovering well after her knee operation.
ex.zh: 我姑姑膝盖手术后恢复得很好。

ex.en: The successful operation of public transport systems depends on reliable funding and careful long-term planning.
ex.zh: 公共交通系统的成功运作有赖于可靠的资金支持和周密的长期规划。

tip: 手术部位用on连接：an operation on the knee。

senses.en: Belief that someone or something is honest, reliable, or safe.
To believe someone or something is honest, reliable, or safe.
An arrangement or organisation managing money or property for others.

ex.en: I trust my neighbour to feed our cat.
ex.zh: 我信得过邻居，放心让他喂我们的猫。

ex.en: Public trust in scientific advice depends partly on how clearly researchers communicate uncertainty and evidence.
ex.zh: 公众对科学建议的信任，部分取决于研究人员能否清晰地说明不确定性和证据。

col: trust someone to do something｜相信某人会做某事
a charitable trust｜慈善信托机构
tip: trust sb to do sth表示相信某人能可靠地做某事。

senses.en: a period spent doing a particular activity
a formal meeting or period when an official body meets

ex.en: Our first swimming session starts early tomorrow morning.
ex.zh: 我们的第一次游泳课明天一早开始。

ex.en: Regular revision sessions help students retain information more effectively than studying intensively just before examinations.
ex.zh: 定期复习比临考前突击学习更能帮助学生有效记住知识。

col: in session｜正在开会；正在开庭
tip: session强调一段活动时间；semester才通常指学期。

senses.en: A vehicle with several passenger seats, often used by families.
A small van used for transporting goods.

ex.en: Our minivan has enough seats for the whole family.
ex.zh: 我们的小型多座客车有足够的座位，可以坐下全家人。

ex.en: Shared minivan services can improve access to healthcare for rural residents who lack reliable public transport.
ex.zh: 共享小型客车服务可以帮助缺乏可靠公共交通的农村居民更方便地就医。

col: rent a minivan｜租一辆小型客车
tip: 美式常指家庭多座客车，不宜一律译为小货车。

senses.en: the flat area between your waist and knees when sitting
one complete trip around a track or course
to drink with the tongue, or of water, to hit gently

ex.en: The cat sat quietly on her lap while she read a book.
ex.zh: 她看书时，猫安静地坐在她腿上。

ex.en: He was two laps behind the leader but refused to give up the race.
ex.zh: 他落后领先者两圈，但拒绝放弃比赛。

tip: 注意 laptop（笔记本电脑）字面就是“放在膝上的东西”。

senses.en: Happening without being expected or predicted.

ex.en: An unexpected visitor arrived just as we finished lunch.
ex.zh: 我们刚吃完午饭，一位意想不到的客人就来了。

ex.en: Governments need emergency funds to manage unexpected events without reducing essential spending on healthcare and education.
ex.zh: 政府需要应急资金来应对意外事件，避免削减医疗和教育方面的必要支出。

tip: unexpected强调未料到，不一定表示突然发生。

senses.en: Learning done using computers and the internet.

ex.en: E-learning allows students to study at home when schools are closed.
ex.zh: 当学校关闭时，在线学习让学生可以在家学习。

ex.en: The school introduced e-learning tools to help students review lessons after class.
ex.zh: 学校引入了在线学习工具，帮助学生在课后复习功课。

tip: e-learning 不可数，谓语用单数。

senses.en: To formally express a choice in an election or decision.
A formal expression of choice, or the process of choosing.

ex.en: We voted to hold the picnic in the park.
ex.zh: 我们投票决定在公园里野餐。

ex.en: Allowing residents to vote on local projects may increase public participation in community development.
ex.zh: 允许居民就地方项目投票，可能提高公众参与社区发展的积极性。

tip: vote for表示支持；vote against表示反对。

senses.en: a person who has a million or more pounds or dollars

ex.en: The old man became a millionaire but still rides his bicycle to work.
ex.zh: 这位老人成了百万富翁，却仍骑自行车上班。

ex.en: Some people believe a millionaire should give more money to local schools and hospitals.
ex.zh: 有些人认为百万富翁应该给当地学校和医院捐更多的钱。

col: become a millionaire｜成为百万富翁
tip: 重音在第三个音节；billionaire是亿万富翁，注意对比。

senses.en: A fruit with creamy green flesh and a large central stone.

ex.en: She spread ripe avocado on her warm toast.
ex.zh: 她把熟透的牛油果抹在热吐司上。

ex.en: Growing demand for avocados can place pressure on water supplies in regions with limited rainfall.
ex.zh: 在降雨有限的地区，牛油果需求增长可能给供水带来压力。

col: a ripe avocado｜成熟的牛油果
tip: 复数为avocados，不加-es。

senses.en: device that connects computers to the internet

ex.en: The modem in our living room stopped working last night.
ex.zh: 我们客厅的调制解调器昨晚坏了。

ex.en: Students need a reliable modem to attend online classes without interruption.
ex.zh: 学生需要一个可靠的调制解调器来不间断地上网课。

tip: modem是调制解调器，不是路由器；注意与router区分。

senses.en: a person who lives by asking for money
a very poor person, used informally
to make someone poor, or to be too hard to believe

ex.en: A beggar sat quietly near the station with an empty cup.
ex.zh: 一个乞丐拿着空杯子安静地坐在车站附近。

ex.en: The city opened a shelter so that beggars could sleep indoors during the cold winter.
ex.zh: 该市开放了一个收容所，让乞丐在寒冬能在室内睡觉。

tip: 现代英语中 beggar 多指街头乞讨者，语气中性，避免当面称人 beggar。

senses.en: Stop blaming someone or feeling angry about what they did.
Officially allow someone not to repay a debt.

ex.en: Can you forgive me for breaking your favourite mug?
ex.zh: 我打碎了你最喜欢的杯子，你能原谅我吗？

ex.en: International lenders may forgive some debts to help poorer countries invest more in healthcare and education.
ex.zh: 国际贷款机构可能减免部分债务，帮助较贫困国家增加医疗和教育投入。

col: forgive someone for something｜原谅某人某事
tip: 用forgive sb for doing sth；过去式forgave，过去分词forgiven。

senses.en: a vehicle that flies, such as a plane or helicopter

ex.en: A small aircraft flew low over the fields.
ex.zh: 一架小型飞机低空飞过田野。

ex.en: Developing more efficient aircraft could reduce fuel consumption, although growing passenger demand may limit the environmental benefits.
ex.zh: 研发效率更高的飞机可以降低燃料消耗，但不断增长的旅客需求可能限制其环境效益。

tip: aircraft单复数同形，不能加-s。

senses.en: a set of pictures shown one after another

ex.en: Our teacher showed a slideshow about ancient temples.
ex.zh: 我们老师展示了一个关于古庙的幻灯片演示。

ex.en: Each group will present a short slideshow on how to save water at school.
ex.zh: 每组将就如何在校园节水做一个简短的幻灯片展示。

col: give a slideshow｜做幻灯片演示
a slideshow of photos｜照片幻灯片
tip: 一个合成词，写作一个词slideshow，也可说slide show。

senses.en: the bags and suitcases you take when travelling
past experiences or feelings that continue to cause difficulties

ex.en: Our baggage arrived on the next flight this afternoon.
ex.zh: 我们的行李今天下午随下一班飞机到了。

ex.en: Airlines often charge additional fees for checked baggage, increasing the overall cost of travel.
ex.zh: 航空公司常对托运行李额外收费，从而增加旅行的总费用。

tip: 不可数；一件行李说a piece of baggage。

senses.en: willing to give money, time, or help freely
larger or more plentiful than usual or expected

ex.en: Our generous neighbour shared her fresh vegetables with us.
ex.zh: 我们那位大方的邻居把新鲜蔬菜分给了我们。

ex.en: Generous donations from local businesses can help community centres provide affordable activities for children and older residents.
ex.zh: 当地企业的慷慨捐助可以帮助社区中心为儿童和老年居民提供价格实惠的活动。

col: generous with your time｜不吝惜时间
tip: be generous with sth表示在某方面慷慨。

senses.en: writing that is about real facts, not imagined stories

ex.en: She prefers nonfiction to novels because she loves true stories.
ex.zh: 她更喜欢非虚构作品而不是小说，因为她喜欢真实的故事。

ex.en: For his project, he read a nonfiction book about climate change and wrote a report on it.
ex.zh: 为了他的项目，他读了一本关于气候变化的非虚构书籍，并就此写了一篇报告。

tip: nonfiction 指基于事实的写作，如传记、历史、科普；小说是 fiction。

senses.en: Water covering land that is normally dry.
To cover with water or become covered with water.
A large amount of something arriving at once.

ex.en: The flood left our garden covered in thick mud.
ex.zh: 洪水退去后，我们的花园覆满了厚厚的淤泥。

ex.en: Restoring wetlands can reduce flood risks by allowing excess rainwater to spread and drain naturally.
ex.zh: 恢复湿地可以让多余雨水自然扩散和排走，从而降低洪灾风险。

col: a flood of complaints｜大量涌来的投诉
tip: 读音与 blood 的元音相同，不与 food 押韵。

senses.en: A wild animal with pointed ears and a bushy tail.
To confuse someone or make a problem difficult to solve.

ex.en: A fox slipped through the garden before sunrise.
ex.zh: 日出前，一只狐狸悄悄穿过花园。

ex.en: The red fox can adapt to urban environments where food is readily available from human activity.
ex.zh: 赤狐能够适应城市环境，因为人类活动使食物很容易获取。

col: an urban fox｜城市里的狐狸
tip: 作动词表示“难倒”，主要用于英式非正式语境。

senses.en: to ask for something very seriously
to ask people for money or food

ex.en: The boy begged his mother to let him keep the little dog.
ex.zh: 男孩恳求母亲让他留下那只小狗。

ex.en: Charities often beg the government for more money to help homeless people in winter.
ex.zh: 慈善机构常常恳求政府增加拨款，以在冬季帮助无家可归者。

col: beg sb to do sth｜恳求某人做某事
I beg your pardon｜请再说一遍；对不起
tip: beg sb to do sth 是常见结构；I beg your pardon 常用于没听清或道歉。

senses.en: Using the temperature scale with water freezing at zero

ex.en: It was thirty degrees centigrade in the shade today.
ex.zh: 今天阴凉处的气温达到了三十摄氏度。

ex.en: A rise of two degrees centigrade in average temperatures could significantly affect agricultural production in vulnerable regions.
ex.zh: 平均气温上升两摄氏度可能对脆弱地区的农业生产产生显著影响。

tip: 通常说degrees centigrade；现代科学更常用Celsius。

senses.en: having the usual features of a particular group or situation
showing the behaviour or qualities usually associated with someone

ex.en: A typical weekday starts with breakfast and a walk.
ex.zh: 平常的工作日都是从吃早餐和散步开始的。

ex.en: Long commuting times are typical of large cities where housing near employment centres is expensive.
ex.zh: 在就业中心附近住房昂贵的大城市，通勤时间长是常见现象。

tip: 用typical of表示具有某人或某物的典型特征。

senses.en: to make something stronger

ex.en: Daily exercise will strengthen your legs and help you sleep better.
ex.zh: 每天锻炼能增强腿部力量，还有助于睡眠。

ex.en: Schools should strengthen mental health support so students can deal with study pressure.
ex.zh: 学校应加强对心理健康的支持，让学生能应对学习压力。

tip: 动词拼写有 g，但读音不含 /g/，注意别写成 strenth。

senses.en: The study of shapes, angles, sizes, and spatial relationships.

ex.en: We used colourful wooden shapes in geometry class today.
ex.zh: 今天的几何课上，我们使用了彩色的木制图形。

ex.en: Learning geometry helps students develop spatial reasoning skills that are valuable in engineering and architecture.
ex.zh: 学习几何有助于学生培养空间推理能力，这种能力在工程和建筑领域很有价值。

tip: 学科名，不可数；通常不加冠词。

senses.en: a person whose job is to guard a building at night

ex.en: The watchman checked every door of the factory before going home.
ex.zh: 守夜人回家前检查了工厂的每一扇门。

ex.en: A friendly watchman at the museum told us where the night entrance was.
ex.zh: 博物馆一位友善的看守人告诉我们夜间入口在哪里。

col: work as a watchman｜当看守人
tip: watching man 不是标准说法，表“看守人”用 watchman 或 guard。

senses.en: the state of not having a job

ex.en: Unemployment rose sharply when the factory closed last year.
ex.zh: 去年工厂关闭时失业率急剧上升。

ex.en: The government has promised to reduce youth unemployment by creating more training programs.
ex.zh: 政府承诺通过创造更多培训项目来降低青年失业率。

tip: 不可数名词；常与 rate, rise, fall 搭配。

senses.en: happening or done again and again
said or did something again

ex.en: Repeated phone calls kept interrupting our quiet dinner.
ex.zh: 接连不断的电话打断了我们安静的晚餐。

ex.en: Repeated exposure to new vocabulary helps learners remember words and use them more confidently.
ex.zh: 反复接触新词汇有助于学习者记住单词，并更自信地运用它们。

tip: repeated强调多次发生；repetitive常暗示单调乏味。

senses.en: the feeling or mood of a place or situation
the mixture of gases surrounding a planet

ex.en: Soft lighting gave the little restaurant a relaxed atmosphere.
ex.zh: 柔和的灯光为这家小餐馆营造了轻松的氛围。

ex.en: A supportive classroom atmosphere encourages students to ask questions and participate more actively in discussions.
ex.zh: 相互支持的课堂氛围鼓励学生提问，并更加积极地参与讨论。

tip: 表示某种氛围常用an atmosphere；地球大气用the atmosphere。

senses.en: to look over something quickly or copy it with a machine
a quick look or a medical test using a machine

ex.en: She scanned the page to find her name on the list.
ex.zh: 她快速扫了一遍页面，想在名单上找到自己的名字。

ex.en: Doctors can use a brain scan to find out whether the injury is serious.
ex.zh: 医生可以用脑部扫描来查明伤势是否严重。

tip: scan a QR code（扫二维码）很常用；“浏览”强调快速，不等同仔细阅读。

senses.en: very strange and difficult to understand or explain

ex.en: It felt weird to walk into an empty classroom.
ex.zh: 走进空荡荡的教室感觉很奇怪。

ex.en: Some people find it weird that she talks to her plants every morning before school.
ex.zh: 有些人觉得她每天上学前和植物说话很奇怪。

tip: 比 strange 更口语化，常指“诡异得说不清”；不用于正式学术写作。

senses.en: A group chosen to govern an area or manage affairs.

ex.en: The local council repaired the playground near our house.
ex.zh: 地方议会修好了我们家附近的游乐场。

ex.en: The city council should consult residents before approving developments that could affect public green spaces.
ex.zh: 市议会在批准可能影响公共绿地的开发项目之前，应征询居民意见。

tip: council指议会或委员会；counsel指建议或劝告。

senses.en: to make someone eager to do something
to provide the reason for someone's actions

ex.en: Training with a friend motivates me to exercise regularly.
ex.zh: 和朋友一起训练能激励我坚持锻炼。

ex.en: Teachers can motivate students to explore difficult subjects by connecting classroom lessons with everyday experiences.
ex.zh: 教师可以把课堂内容与日常经历联系起来，激励学生探索难学的科目。

col: motivate someone to do something｜激励某人做某事
tip: 常用motivate sb to do；by后可接动机。

senses.en: the feeling of being annoyed
soreness or discomfort in a part of the body

ex.en: He sighed with irritation when the phone rang again.
ex.zh: 电话又响了，他烦躁地叹了口气。

ex.en: Exposure to household cleaning products may cause skin irritation, especially among people with sensitive skin.
ex.zh: 接触家用清洁产品可能引起皮肤刺激，皮肤敏感者尤其如此。

col: a source of irritation｜令人恼火的事物
tip: 既可指情绪上的恼怒，也可指皮肤等受到刺激。

senses.en: involving communication or two-way action

ex.en: The museum has an interactive display for children.
ex.zh: 博物馆有一个供儿童互动的展品。

ex.en: Interactive whiteboards make lessons more engaging for students.
ex.zh: 交互式白板使课程对学生更有吸引力。

tip: 强调双向交流或参与，如互动学习、互动游戏。

senses.en: A large hole in the ground
An area where racing cars stop for servicing
The hard central part of certain fruits

ex.en: We dug a shallow pit for the new tree.
ex.zh: 我们挖了一个浅坑，准备栽这棵新树。

ex.en: Abandoned mining pits can threaten local ecosystems unless restoration projects stabilise the soil and improve water quality.
ex.zh: 废弃矿坑可能威胁当地生态系统，除非修复项目能稳固土壤并改善水质。

col: a pit stop｜赛车进站检修
tip: 维修区常用the pits；果核义主要用于美式英语。

senses.en: The study of knowledge, existence, reality, and moral values
A set of beliefs that guides actions and decisions

ex.en: My sister studies philosophy and enjoys discussing difficult questions.
ex.zh: 我姐姐学习哲学，喜欢讨论难解的问题。

ex.en: Studying philosophy can help students question assumptions and develop stronger arguments about complex ethical issues.
ex.zh: 学习哲学有助于学生质疑既有假设，并就复杂的伦理问题提出更有力的论证。

tip: 指学科通常不可数；指某套理念可用a philosophy。

senses.en: the strength to keep doing something for a long time

ex.en: Running every morning has given her more stamina than before.
ex.zh: 每天晨跑让她比以前更有耐力。

ex.en: Long study hours demand mental stamina, so students should sleep well and take short breaks.
ex.zh: 长时间学习需要心理耐力，因此学生应睡好并短暂休息。

tip: 不可数名词；常与build up, lack, mental搭配。

senses.en: A short trip to buy, collect, or deliver something

ex.en: I ran an errand before meeting you for lunch.
ex.zh: 和你见面吃午饭前，我出去办了点事。

ex.en: Reliable neighbourhood transport helps older residents run errands independently and maintain regular contact with their communities.
ex.zh: 可靠的社区交通能帮助老年居民独立外出办事，并与社区保持日常联系。

col: send someone on an errand｜派某人跑腿
a quick errand｜很快能办完的差事
tip: 通常指外出办小事；常搭配run errands。

senses.en: extremely beautiful or impressive
causing great surprise or shock

ex.en: We enjoyed a stunning view from the hilltop.
ex.zh: 我们在山顶欣赏了绝美的景色。

ex.en: The region's stunning coastal scenery attracts visitors, but increased tourism places pressure on fragile ecosystems.
ex.zh: 该地区绝美的海岸风光吸引着游客，但旅游业增长也给脆弱的生态系统带来压力。

col: a stunning victory｜令人震惊的胜利
tip: stunning形容事物令人惊叹；stunned形容人惊呆了。

senses.en: a thick sweet liquid made from dissolved sugar
a sweet thick liquid containing medicine

ex.en: She poured a little syrup over her warm pancakes.
ex.zh: 她在热乎乎的煎饼上浇了一点糖浆。

ex.en: Fruit preserved in syrup often contains more added sugar than fresh fruit, which may concern health-conscious consumers.
ex.zh: 糖浆保存的水果通常比新鲜水果含有更多添加糖，这可能让注重健康的消费者担忧。

tip: 通常不可数；止咳糖浆说cough syrup。

senses.en: to mix with a liquid and become part of it
to officially end an organization or marriage

ex.en: Sugar will dissolve quickly in hot water.
ex.zh: 糖在热水中会迅速溶解。

ex.en: The government decided to dissolve the parliament and call for new elections.
ex.zh: 政府决定解散议会并要求举行新的选举。

tip: 既指物理上的“溶解”，也指组织、婚姻等的“解散”。

senses.en: A statement about what is likely to happen in the future.
To say what will probably happen, using available information.

ex.en: The weather forecast says we should expect snow tonight.
ex.zh: 天气预报说今晚可能会下雪。

ex.en: Economists forecast slower growth next year as rising energy costs place greater pressure on businesses.
ex.zh: 经济学家预测，随着能源成本上涨给企业带来更大压力，明年的经济增长将放缓。

tip: 过去式和过去分词通常用forecast，也可用forecasted。

senses.en: A small amount of air, smoke, or steam released suddenly.
To breathe quickly and noisily after physical effort.
To release air or smoke, or swell with air.

ex.en: A puff of steam escaped from the kettle.
ex.zh: 一小团蒸汽从水壶里冒了出来。

ex.en: Older buses release puffs of dark smoke, highlighting the need for cleaner public transport in cities.
ex.zh: 老旧公交车排出一团团黑烟，凸显了城市发展更清洁公共交通的必要性。

col: puff out your cheeks｜鼓起腮帮子
tip: 一团烟用a puff of smoke；puff也可表示喘粗气。

senses.en: able to make decisions quickly
very important in deciding a result

ex.en: She is a decisive leader who acts quickly in a crisis.
ex.zh: 她是一位果断的领导者，在危机中行动迅速。

ex.en: Teamwork played a decisive role in the success of our project.
ex.zh: 团队合作在我们项目的成功中起了决定性作用。

tip: decisive 是“果断的；决定性的”，不要与 decided（明确的）混淆。

senses.en: A legally protected name or symbol identifying a company's products.
A distinctive feature strongly associated with someone or something.
To register a name or symbol for legal protection.

ex.en: The bakery's trademark is a tiny golden wheat stalk.
ex.zh: 这家面包店的商标是一株小小的金色麦穗。

ex.en: Registering a trademark helps small businesses protect their identity and distinguish their products from those of competitors.
ex.zh: 注册商标有助于小企业保护自身品牌形象，并使其产品区别于竞争对手的产品。

tip: 商标用trademark；版权用copyright，保护对象不同。

senses.en: Products applied to the face or body to improve appearance.

ex.en: She keeps her cosmetics in a small bathroom drawer.
ex.zh: 她把化妆品放在浴室的一个小抽屉里。

ex.en: Consumers increasingly expect cosmetics manufacturers to disclose ingredients clearly and reduce unnecessary packaging to limit environmental damage.
ex.zh: 消费者越来越希望化妆品制造商明确公开成分，并减少不必要的包装以降低环境危害。

tip: 通常用复数；cosmetic作形容词也指表面的。

senses.zh: 亲切友善的；易于交谈的
senses.en: friendly and easy to talk to
easy to understand or enjoy without special knowledge

ex.en: Our new teacher seems approachable, so I asked for help.
ex.zh: 我们的新老师看起来很亲切，所以我向老师求助了。

ex.en: Approachable healthcare professionals may encourage patients to discuss sensitive concerns before their conditions become more serious.
ex.zh: 亲切的医护人员可能促使患者在病情加重前谈及难以启齿的顾虑。

col: friendly and approachable｜友善且平易近人的
an approachable style｜浅显易懂的风格
tip: 形容人时重在容易交谈、让人敢于求助。

senses.en: To let someone or something go free or escape.
To make information or a product available to the public.
The act of freeing or publishing; something newly made available.

ex.en: We released the butterfly outside after checking its wings.
ex.zh: 检查过蝴蝶的翅膀后，我们把它放到了室外。

ex.en: Governments should release reliable environmental data so that citizens can evaluate the effectiveness of climate policies.
ex.zh: 政府应公布可靠的环境数据，让公民能够评估气候政策的成效。

tip: release可指释放，也可指公开发布报告或产品。

senses.en: making you feel affection, sympathy, or gentle sadness
putting a hand or another body part against something

ex.en: Her touching farewell brought tears to my eyes.
ex.zh: 她感人的道别让我热泪盈眶。

ex.en: The documentary offers a touching account of volunteers helping older residents overcome loneliness in urban communities.
ex.zh: 这部纪录片动人地讲述了志愿者帮助城市社区的老年居民克服孤独的故事。

tip: touching形容事情感人；touched形容人受到感动。

senses.en: someone with little experience in a particular activity

ex.en: As a gardening novice, I often forget to water seedlings.
ex.zh: 作为园艺新手，我常常忘记给幼苗浇水。

ex.en: Structured mentoring can help a novice develop the confidence needed to manage a classroom effectively.
ex.zh: 有系统的指导能帮助新手建立有效管理课堂所需的信心。

tip: 表示某方面的新手，常用a novice at/in。

senses.en: of a satisfactory or reasonably good standard
honest, kind, or socially acceptable

ex.en: We finally found a decent flat near the station.
ex.zh: 我们终于在车站附近找到了一套像样的公寓。

ex.en: Every worker should earn enough to afford decent housing and meet their basic needs.
ex.zh: 每位劳动者都应有足够的收入，住上像样的住房并满足基本需求。

tip: 表示质量时是“还不错”，不等于“极好”。

senses.en: sending out harmful energy that can damage health

ex.en: These gloves protect workers from radioactive materials.
ex.zh: 这些手套保护工人免受放射性物质伤害。

ex.en: Scientists warn that radioactive waste must be stored safely for thousands of years.
ex.zh: 科学家警告说，放射性废料必须安全储存数千年。

tip: 常与waste、material搭配；名词是radiation或radioactivity。

senses.en: a place where young children are cared for
a place where young plants are grown for sale
a room in a home for a baby or young child

ex.en: My daughter painted a bright yellow duck at nursery.
ex.zh: 我女儿在幼儿园画了一只鲜黄色的鸭子。

ex.en: Affordable nursery places allow more parents to return to work while their children receive professional care.
ex.zh: 价格可负担的托幼名额能让更多父母重返职场，同时让孩子得到专业照护。

tip: 英式英语中at nursery常指在托儿所。

senses.en: A person with deep knowledge of an academic subject.
A student awarded money to study because of their abilities.

ex.en: The scholar carefully examined an old book in the library.
ex.zh: 这位学者在图书馆仔细研究一本古书。

ex.en: Scholars increasingly argue that access to early education can reduce social inequality over the long term.
ex.zh: 越来越多学者认为，获得早期教育的机会能够长期减少社会不平等。

tip: scholar通常指学者，不是普通学生。

senses.en: connected with moral rules about right and wrong
morally right or acceptable

ex.en: The scientist raised an ethical question about testing on animals.
ex.zh: 这位科学家提出了关于动物实验的伦理问题。

ex.en: Many students believe that buying exam answers online is not an ethical choice.
ex.zh: 许多学生认为在网上购买考试答案是种不道德的选择。

tip: ethics 是伦理学、道德准则；ethical 修饰行为是否合乎道德。

senses.en: A large public meeting supporting a cause or expressing opinions.
To gather people together to support someone or something.
To regain strength or improve after a difficult period.

ex.en: Hundreds attended a peaceful rally in the town square.
ex.zh: 数百人参加了镇广场上的和平集会。

ex.en: Community leaders rallied support for a public library, arguing that free access to information benefits everyone.
ex.zh: 社区领袖争取大家支持建设公共图书馆，认为免费获取信息能让所有人受益。

col: rally around someone｜团结起来支持某人
tip: rally support for表示“为……争取支持”。

senses.en: The quality of staying similar in behaviour, standards, or results.
How thick, firm, or smooth a substance is.

ex.en: Our coach values consistency more than occasional brilliant performances.
ex.zh: 我们的教练更看重稳定发挥，而不是偶尔的出色表现。

ex.en: Greater consistency in marking standards would help ensure that students receive fair results across different examination centres.
ex.zh: 提高评分标准的一致性，有助于确保不同考点的学生获得公平的成绩。

col: consistency in quality｜质量的稳定性
a smooth consistency｜细腻均匀的质地
tip: 表示某方面的一致性用 consistency in。

senses.en: to not give enough care or attention to
the state of not being cared for

ex.en: He neglected his homework and spent the evening playing games.
ex.zh: 他忽略了作业，整晚都在玩游戏。

ex.en: Many old buildings in the town have been neglected for years and now look terrible.
ex.zh: 镇上的许多老建筑多年来一直被忽视，现在看起来破败不堪。

tip: neglect 强调“未给予应有的照顾”，ignore 强调“故意不理睬”。

senses.en: to speak with unwanted pauses and repeated sounds
a speech problem that makes someone repeat sounds

ex.en: He stammered a little when the teacher asked him a surprise question.
ex.zh: 老师突然问了他一个问题，他有点结巴。

ex.en: People who stammer often feel nervous in class, so teachers should give them time to speak.
ex.zh: 口吃的人在课堂上常感到紧张，所以老师应给他们说话的时间。

col: speak with a stammer｜说话口吃
tip: stammer与stutter意思相近；注意礼貌，不宜拿口吃开玩笑。

senses.en: a person who is 100 years old or older
relating to a person who is 100 or more years old

ex.en: The centenarian still walks in the park every morning.
ex.zh: 这位百岁老人每天早上还在公园散步。

ex.en: Scientists study centenarians to learn why some people live much longer than others.
ex.zh: 科学家研究百岁老人，以了解为什么有些人比其他人长寿得多。

col: a healthy centenarian｜健康的百岁老人
tip: centenarian 指100岁及以上的人；century 是“世纪；一百年”，注意词根联系。

senses.en: a mention of someone or something
consultation for information, or a source used in writing
a recommendation or someone who recommends you for work

ex.en: Her speech included a warm reference to her grandmother.
ex.zh: 她在演讲中温情地提到了祖母。

ex.en: Academic essays should include accurate references so readers can locate the original sources of information.
ex.zh: 学术文章应包含准确的引文出处，以便读者找到信息的原始来源。

tip: reference to表示提及；for reference表示供参考。

senses.en: The belief that good things will happen.

ex.en: Her optimism helped us stay cheerful during the storm.
ex.zh: 暴风雨期间，她的乐观让我们保持了好心情。

ex.en: Despite economic uncertainty, many graduates express optimism about their chances of finding meaningful employment.
ex.zh: 尽管经济形势不明朗，许多毕业生仍对找到有意义的工作持乐观态度。

col: optimism about the future｜对未来的乐观态度
tip: 不可数名词；对某事乐观常用optimism about。

senses.en: A belief or rule that guides decisions and behaviour.
A basic truth explaining how something works.

ex.en: I refused the extra money as a matter of principle.
ex.zh: 出于原则，我拒绝了那笔额外的钱。

ex.en: The principle of equal opportunity should guide policies designed to improve access to higher education.
ex.zh: 旨在改善高等教育入学机会的政策应以机会平等原则为指导。

col: basic principle｜基本原则；基本原理
tip: 勿混principal：它可指“主要的”或“校长”。
